---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest an idea for this project
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Problem Statement

A clear and concise description of what problem this feature would solve. Ex. I'm always frustrated when [...]

## Proposed Solution

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

## Use Case

Describe the specific use case(s) for this feature. How would you or others use it?

## Alternatives Considered

A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Freshdesk API Reference

If this feature relates to a specific Freshdesk API endpoint, please link to the documentation:
(e.g., https://developers.freshdesk.com/api/#tickets)

## Implementation Ideas

If you have ideas on how this could be implemented, please share them here.

## Additional Context

Add any other context, screenshots, or examples about the feature request here.

## Would You Be Willing to Contribute?

- [ ] Yes, I'd like to submit a PR for this feature
- [ ] Maybe, with guidance from maintainers
- [ ] No, I'm just suggesting the idea
